basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic designer from Vancouver, Canada, exploring Reddit to expand my knowledge in gaming and visual aesthetics. I enjoy gaming, especially VALORANT, and love tweaking visual settings to enhance my experience. I dislike clutter and inefficiency, which is why I often browse 'PetPeeves'. I'm in a relationship and live with my partner and our two cats. I usually browse Reddit during the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital design, having completed a diploma in Graphic Design from a local college. My interest in gaming visuals comes from my work, where I often experiment with colors and themes. I learn about new gaming settings through online forums, tutorials, and by trying things out myself.
